release_notes:
- Added Cloud firmware source — switch between Local file and Cloud (Z: drive) in the Firmware Image section
- Cloud mode shows the 5 latest release versions, pre-labeled while downloading ("Fetching v0.4.39.R1…"), updating to the real version name once ready
- Firmware images are cached locally so Cloud burns work even when Z: drive is temporarily unavailable
- Stale cached versions are automatically removed when newer releases are detected on Z: drive
- Burn button stays disabled until at least one version is fully downloaded and ready
- Clear status messages when Z: drive is unreachable — distinguishes between no access, cached fallback, and mid-download disconnection
